instruction: Add the Files application to your favorites in the dock.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding the Files application (org.gnome.Nautilus.desktop) to GNOME favorites. The evaluator checks that: (1) the Files app is present in favorites, (2) all original apps remain, and (3) exactly one app was added. This validates the user successfully added a new favorite without removing existing ones.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies all instruction requirements
Getter extracts the correct state using 'gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps'
Metric checks three critical aspects: (1) expected app is present, (2) all original apps remain, (3) exactly one app was added
Expected values are semantically correct: 'org.gnome.Nautilus.desktop' is the correct desktop file for GNOME Files application
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('expected_app') and expected.get('original_apps')
Robust error handling with ast.literal_eval() for parsing gsettings output
No postconfig needed as GNOME favorites state persists after task completion
Complete coverage - all instruction requirements are verified
